conflicts.permit: Our apps relies on technology called Unity Analytics to monitor and collect data about player activities within the apps.
conflicts.prohibit: When you download and use our apps we don’t require that you provide any information nor we do not collect any information about you.
conflicts.situation: A user downloads and plays an app released before 2018.
conflicts.reason: The policy states it does not collect any information about the user upon downloading/using the app, while simultaneously stating it uses Unity Analytics to monitor and collect player activity data.

conflicts.permit: Our kids apps relies on technology called Unity Analytics to monitor and collect data about player activities within the app.
conflicts.prohibit: When you download and use our kids apps we don’t require that you provide any information nor we do not collect any information about you.
conflicts.situation: A user downloads and uses an educational app designed for kids.
conflicts.reason: The policy flatly asserts that no information is collected about the user, yet explicitly states it monitors and collects data about player activities within the app via Unity Analytics.
